post.originalText:
Same prompt, one shot: an interactive Tokyo street alley at night in the rain.

- Claude Opus 5.5: 34m 14s | ~30.7M tokens | $12.82
- GPT-6.1 Sol: ~16m 42s | ~7.8M tokens | $1.76

Costs are estimated API prices.

Sol gave it a little moody, minimal vibe. But Opus went all out on the neon bloom, steam vents, arcade machines, and street props. 

Opus cost 7x more, but visually it feels like a finished scene with much more details. Which vibe do you prefer here?
